scaled_whitebox_docmia.description: White-box, auxiliary-data-free document-level membership inference against a document VQA model fine-tuned from a public pre-trained checkpoint, on 1200 hidden candidate documents (600 members, 600 non-members). The ranked row is the submitted attack (membership_attack). Paper reference: DocMIA white-box results against Donut on DocVQA (Tables 1, 11, 12, 16); the paper's FL variant is its best-average variant there.
scaled_whitebox_docmia._scaling_note: Scaled setting: procedural DocVQA-style forms (80x96 px, 5 fields, 1-5 questions per document) and a ~1.1M-parameter OCR-free reader pre-trained on a public generated corpus and fine-tuned for 8 epochs on 600 private documents (member/non-member QA accuracy ~97%/~60%, close to the paper's DocVQA train-test gaps), instead of DocVQA and the 201M-parameter Donut. The paper's numbers below are the published reference; the gym ranks submissions against its own reproduced reference run (scoring/scores_test.json). The paper attacks up to 10 questions per document; here each document's 1-5 questions are available.

_table18_member_recall_at_most_2_questio._note: Table 18, Donut/DocVQA, member documents with m=1 (51) and m=2 (60) training questions, pooled.

balanced_accuracy.description: Balanced accuracy of the attack's member/non-member decisions (the paper's ACC).

f1.description: F1 of the member class from the attack's decisions (the paper's headline metric).

tpr_at_1_fpr.description: True positive rate at <=1% false positive rate from the attack's membership scores (paper Tables 12, 16).

tpr_at_3_fpr.description: True positive rate at <=3% false positive rate from the attack's membership scores (paper Tables 2 and 4, main text).

roc_auc.description: Diagnostic only: threshold-free ranking quality of the membership scores (not reported by the paper).
